newsitem.title: LEBANON: BLC steady, Solidere falls on Beirut exchange.
newsitem.headline: BLC steady, Solidere falls on Beirut exchange.

text.p: Shares of Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce were steady and Solidere shares fell on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
BLC shares held steady at $12.375 on trade of 5,000 shares -- both price and volume unchanged from Tuesday's.

BLC is the first commercial bank to list on the Beirut exchange since the market reopened in January 1995. The BLC shares had risen steadily since listing on the market on December 30 and closing that day at $11.25.
Solidere A shares fell 1.1 percent to $11 from $11.125 on Tuesday and B shares fell 4.6 percent to $10.875 from $11.375.
Turnover in Solidere rose slightly to 16,686 shares from 15,880 a day earlier and value was $182,296.25 from $177,757.5.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.70 percent to 81.35 and the BLOM stock index fell 2.31 percent to 919.9.
